F01 close gate remediation

The first close attempt stopped because the 24 acceptance criteria remained unchecked. After the standalone verifier had marked all criteria met, the checklist was updated. The atomic close verifier then returned FAIL on `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the project test gate because those outcomes were recorded on this session log instead of the F01 ticket, and the criteria lacked the required `[non-codebase]` tag. The three criteria now carry that tag. The command results, CI run, Gerrit votes, and merge commit are recorded on cosies-pegmatite-ibex for the next pinned verification.
